analysis.reason: 최근 5일간 -5.36% 하락으로 RSI 34.6까지 하락하며 과매도 구간 진입. analysis.reasonEn: Recent 5-day -5.36% decline pushed RSI to 34.6, entering oversold territory. MACD histogram also worsened to -37.1395, reinforcing bearish momentum. Weekly ADX at 30.9 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is higher than +DI, showing bearish pressure. Current price $2,362.9 is 10.95% above weekly SMA20 ($2,129.61) and 4.58% above SMA100 ($2,250.96). It is 56.8% above the 52-week low ($1,506.51) and 44.4% below the 52-week high ($4,250.67). Sideways movement likely near swing support $2,359.58 and resistance $2,384.47. Increased volume suggests rising selling pressure amidst decline. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
